name: Evasive Nomad
text:
**Evasive Nomad**: Song’o halflings rarely grow up in one place, as they are quick to move to a new home whenever they are discovered. Halflings with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Reflex saves, but they take a –2 penalty on saving throws against fear effects.

This replaces fearless.
